notes: HER 0.1.0-hashi.19 preserves the complete normalized fixed-session message view for every planning-enabled checkpoint, then appends a request-local task-control envelope and requests provider-native JSON output so long conversations cannot turn a TaskFrame checkpoint into ordinary prose or tool execution. MEDIUM, HIGH, XHIGH, MAX, and MAX+ planning, replanning, self-review, and direct-response finalization share this contract; LOW remains planning-disabled. The envelope is never persisted and grants no user authority. This HASHI1 release certifies the Linux x86-64 package only; the prior Windows 0.1.0-hashi.16 artifact remains archived but is not represented as a 0.1.0-hashi.19 build.
